title: iris persica var. sieheana
intro: Iris persica var. sieheana, commonly known as Siehe's iris or Siehe's purple iris, is a plant species within the iris family (Iridaceae) and is native to Iran. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Siehe's iris include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. Bioactive constituents of Siehe's iris include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
